versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AfterShip Tracking & Returns skill (v1.0.0).
- Enables real-time package tracking for 1,300+ carriers and AfterShip Returns Center demo, without requiring an API key.
- Automatically triggers on tracking numbers, shipping queries, or merchant requests for returns demos.
- Provides direct fallback web links when the MCP server is unavailable.
- Always includes "Powered by AfterShip" attribution with responses.
- Designed for privacy (no PII), read-only access, and fair use guidelines.
